purpose: Test six distinct executable mechanisms with observable state changes, matched sham controls, competitive baselines, ablations, and deterministic resource accounting.
non_claims: Does not demonstrate AGI or superintelligence.
GitHub jobs are deterministic compute jobs, not AI agents.
Repeated seeds are not independent methodological replications.
A module name is not evidence that the corresponding capability exists.

historical_data_policy.promotion_holdout: Must be generated only after implementations, metrics, budgets, thresholds, dependencies and candidate hashes are frozen.

blocks.name: representation_world_model
blocks.mechanism: Infer a compact transition model from observations and predict interventions.
blocks.failure_condition: No gain over sham at matched budget or gain disappears under symbol permutation.

blocks.name: reasoning_creativity
blocks.mechanism: Construct valid derivations or novel procedures for constraint tasks.
blocks.failure_condition: No gain over competitive search or proposed novelty is only surface diversity.

blocks.name: planning_experimentation
blocks.mechanism: Choose actions or experiments that reduce uncertainty and reach goals.
blocks.sham_control: random action selection with same interaction count
blocks.failure_condition: No improvement in regret or information gain over matched random control.

blocks.name: verification_metacognition
blocks.mechanism: Detect invalid candidates, calibrate confidence and abstain selectively.
blocks.failure_condition: False-positive rate not reduced, or apparent accuracy comes only from lower coverage.

blocks.name: learning_transfer
blocks.mechanism: Update strategy after verified failures and transfer to structurally related but surface-different tasks.
blocks.failure_condition: Gain limited to replay, nearest-neighbour retrieval, or becomes negative out of family.

blocks.name: cooperation_self_improvement
blocks.mechanism: Propose a reversible process modification, freeze it, and test it against the prior version.
blocks.sham_control: random modifications from the same search space and budget
blocks.failure_condition: Gain disappears against random search, uses holdout feedback, or causes material domain regression.

matrix.note: Each job executes all paired conditions on the same tasks. max-parallel is a scheduling ceiling, not proof of simultaneous execution.

resource_accounting.rule: All learning, selection, source-prior construction, coordination and verification costs count.
resource_accounting.limitation: Counters approximate work and must not be described as exact FLOP equality unless separately instrumented.

statistics.primary_analysis: paired effect by seed with confidence interval
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm correction across six primary block hypotheses at familywise alpha 0.05
statistics.minimum_useful_effect: Must be fixed per block during development before holdout generation.
statistics.regression_rule: No prespecified material regression in either holdout family.

promotion_gate: Implementation and tests pass before holdout generation.
Candidate, baseline, sham, grader, dependencies and budgets are frozen by hashes.
Active mechanism beats competitive baseline and sham by the preregistered useful margin.
Ablation removes the measured effect without changing information access or total budget.
Isolation canaries and access logs pass.
Prospective replication uses fresh tasks not consulted during development.

jobs_may_launch_when: Each block detects injected positive and negative controls.
No known syntax, leakage or polarity defect remains.

b1_development_protocol.task: One-step prediction of fully observed binary controlled dynamical systems.

families.name: affine_gf2
families.equation: x_next = A*x XOR B*u XOR c over GF(2)

families.name: local_xor_ring
families.equation: Each next-state bit is an unknown XOR mask over local state neighbours and action bits plus bias.

b1_development_protocol.intervention_policy: Actions are externally sampled and included in the public solver input; latent matrices, masks and query targets remain grader-only.
b1_development_protocol.primary_loss: Mean next-state bit error on query transitions, averaged per seed then across seeds.

conditions.active: Infer a compact GF(2) transition model from fit data, freeze it, choose only among preregistered model classes using validation data, then predict query transitions.
conditions.competitive_baseline: Validation-selected empirical nearest-neighbour / per-bit majority transition predictor with the same public observations and charged prediction work.
conditions.sham: Same model representation, dimensions and fitting interface as active, but fit targets are shuffled using a public development-only sham seed independent of task/query seeds.
conditions.ablation: No persistent fitted model; recompute predictions from the same fit observations for each query and charge every recomputation.
conditions.budget_reallocation: Baseline may spend the active condition's unused operation allowance on additional preregistered candidate evaluation, never on extra data.

b1_development_protocol.representation_test: Apply a consistent invertible permutation of state coordinates to fit, validation and query inputs; retrain each condition; score after inverse mapping. The permutation is fixed per development seed and unavailable as a special feature.
b1_development_protocol.development_decision: Sensitivity and implementation validation only. Results cannot promote any architecture.
